decision.explanation: The question asks specifically about the Sumter County Courthouse in Alabama. Document D1S2 explicitly states that the Sumter County Courthouse in Alabama was completed in 1902. This aligns with the scope of the question and is directly supported by the source. Other candidates (1850, 1912–1914, 1907) refer to different courthouses in other states (South Carolina, Florida), or to earlier structures in Alabama that were destroyed or replaced. These are not relevant to the current Sumter County Courthouse in Alabama.
